title: Barachia
summary: Raleigh names Barachia in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Barachia, the father of Asaph. He is not lehoida, also called Barachias, the father of Zacharias slaine betweene the Temple and the Altar. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VIII, sig. 299b
